name: role-super-user
description: Test tooling for the Super-User role mu-plugin: wp-env (single-site + multisite) running the PHPUnit spec, plus a WP-CLI smoke test.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run env:start && npm run env:start:multisite && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/mu-plugins composer install --no-interaction
scripts.test:cli: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/mu-plugins/tests/cli-smoke.php
scripts.test:cli:multisite: wp-env run cli --config=./.wp-env.multisite.json wp eval-file wp-content/mu-plugins/tests/cli-smoke.php
scripts.test:all: npm run env:start && npm run env:start:multisite && npm run test && npm run test:multisite && npm run test:cli && npm run test:cli:multisite
